notes.title: 🌟 Coming Soon: Art-Therapy: Diamonds 🌟
notes.notes:
[p][b]Hello friends![/b]
I’m excited to share some great news — my new game [b]Art-Therapy: Diamonds[/b] is coming very soon.[/p][p]It’s a calm and relaxing game where you place “diamonds” by numbers to complete beautiful artworks. Choose a picture, find the right colors, and gradually fill the canvas. Step by step, scattered dots transform into a full image. It’s a meditative, cozy process — perfect for when you want to unwind, keep your hands busy, and give your mind a break.

🔹 Key Features:[/p][list][*][p]Bigger canvases — more space for your creativity.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved optimization — smooth experience even on low-end PCs.[/p][/*][/list][p]I truly hope Art-Therapy: Diamonds will bring you many peaceful and beautiful evenings.[/p][p]Thank you for supporting my projects and finding joy in them ❤️[/p][p]Stay tuned — release date announcement is coming soon!

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/4004500/ArtTherapy_Diamonds/"][/dynamiclink][/p]
